svg.title: ecc-book-lab
svg.desc: ecc-book-lab: Companion code for the book Error Correction Coding: scripts that reproduce every number and chart MIT, Python, 40 commits. The panel shows the single parity check code from parity_gen.sv with K = 7: data 1011001 sent with parity bit 0 as 01011001, one bit flipped to give 01011101, and the XOR of all bits equal to 1, so the error is detected.

g.text: Companion code for the book Error Correction Coding:
